title: Pharmacist verification
subtitle: Nothing AI-extracted is given until a pharmacist has verified it

steps.caption: The verify queue: medications extracted from signed notes wait here for a pharmacist before they become active orders. Each is run against the interaction knowledge base; when a drug is outside it, Orb says NOT SCREENED instead of pretending.

One row per extracted medication: dose, route and frequency editable, the source marked AI EXTRACTED, the safety line in plain words. Verify or Reject, and either decision is on the record in the pharmacist's name.
